title: Recurrent Networks & NLP Foundations
blurb: Tokenization, word vectors, RNNs, LSTMs, attention, parsing, and CRFs — the building blocks that lead to transformers.

lecture.summary: Build the complete NLP foundation stack from scratch — BPE tokenization, Word2Vec embeddings, vanilla RNNs, LSTMs, and seq2seq models — developing sequential intuition for language on WikiText-2 and AG_NEWS.
takeaways: Tokenization (BPE) and word embeddings — turning text into vectors machines can learn from.
RNNs, LSTMs/GRUs, and seq2seq with attention — sequential modeling before transformers.
Language modeling, perplexity, and text classification, end to end.

snippet.caption: An RNN carries a hidden state across the sequence.

subLessons.title: Sequence Models and NLP
subLessons.intro: Modeling order before transformers: Markov chains, learned word vectors, recurrent state, and the gates that made it trainable.
